decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [insert plan numbers/documents].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Reason : 1 - 1.	The proposed outbuilding, by reason of its inappropriate design and the inclusion of primary living accommodation, by way of a bathroom, would fail to remain incidental to the host dwelling. As such, it would result in harm to the character and appearance of the surrounding area and would adversely affect the living conditions of neighbouring occupiers. Furthermore, in the absence of accurate and comprehensive drawings showing all existing extensions, it has not been demonstrated that the proposed outbuilding would be of an appropriate scale or that sufficient amenity space would be retained following the development. The proposal is therefore considered to be contrary to Local Plan policies CC1 (Context and Character), CC2 (Urban Design and Architecture), and SC7 (Residential Extensions and Alterations) of the adopted Local Plan (2015), as well as the objectives set out within the Residential Extension Guidelines (Part A5 of the Hounslow Character, Sustainability and Design Codes SPD).
description: Erection of an outbuilding to be used as a summer house/gym space.
